common_prompt:
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing.
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one high-fidelity desktop application screen for AutoFlow's second UI refinement. This is an existing Chinese desktop productivity app, not a landing page. Use the attached actual AutoFlow screenshot as structural and brand grounding. Preserve its top global navigation, page header, full-width search/filter toolbar, vertically stacked full-width configuration cards, and pagination. DO NOT add a sidebar, dashboard statistics, workflow editor, invented actions, or new product features.
Target dimensions: 1440 x 1024, exact natural desktop aspect ratio. Flat front-facing edge-to-edge app content, no device frame, no perspective, no giant margins around the app. Omit OS title bar and browser chrome. Everything fits cleanly. One design only, no multiple alternatives, no inset/detail panels, no design-system swatch strips.
Date anchor: 2026-09-12, but do not display dates or time-sensitive claims.
Identity: preserve AutoFlow wordmark and the warm brown overlapping rounded mark from the actual screenshot. Header approximately 74px high. Nav in Chinese: 总览, 浏览器配置 (active), 代理管理, 模型管理; right side 设置 and a small green dot with 本地服务正常. Use matching thin/regular Phosphor-like action icons, duotone for module navigation: home warm clay, browser muted blue, network muted teal, model muted mauve. All primary buttons stay clay brown, not blue or purple.
Page title 浏览器配置, subtitle 管理固定指纹环境，组合浏览器内核与代理资源。 One primary button + 新建配置 top right. Then one horizontal toolbar: long search field with search icon and text 搜索配置名称或描述; right select 全部代理模式 with chevron.
Below, exactly THREE full-width configuration rows/cards stacked vertically. Each row header: a modest browser icon tile, clear name, small edition badge 公开版 and neutral Stable badge, one short description. On right, four aligned compact actions with icons: 编辑, 复制, 重新生成指纹, 删除. Delete should be quiet red text rather than a large filled red button. The row bottom is a precise four-column metadata area separated by a light line: 指纹种子, CloakBrowser 内核, 语言 / 时区, 代理模式. Use regular readable sans Chinese/PingFang-like typography and precise monospace for seeds and version. Never add run/start controls, live counters, checkboxes, switches or model dropdowns to these rows because the existing app does not have them.
Use identical mock contents:
Row 1 name 日常工作环境, description 用于日常网页操作与内容管理, seed 84951, kernel 145.0.7632.109.2, locale zh-CN / Asia/Shanghai, proxy 不使用代理.
Row 2 name 海外业务环境, description 独立语言与时区配置, seed 62738, same kernel 145.0.7632.109.2, locale en-US / America/New_York, proxy 固定代理.
Row 3 name 自动化测试环境, description 用于验证页面交互与执行流程, seed 31596, same kernel, locale zh-CN / Asia/Shanghai, proxy 代理池.
Footer left 共 3 个配置; right 上一页   第 1 / 1 页   下一页, with previous/next visibly disabled. Very small unobtrusive footer text 视觉原型 · 示例数据 to identify mock state.
Warm near-neutral base #F3F1EC, ivory surfaces #FBFAF7, ink #34322E, muted #625E57, brand clay #8D4E2F and pale #F2E3D7, browser blue #476B91/pale #EAF0F7, proxy teal #31756F/pale #E6F1EE, model mauve #75618A/pale #F0EBF5. Greens reserved for actual state. Most surfaces remain neutral, use color intentionally in small areas.
Typography: body/control 14px with20px line-height, note12/18, section16/24 semibold, page24/32 semibold. Header/nav should be readable, crisp and professionally typeset. Adequate contrast for all small text. No super-bold everything, no tiny gray illegible metadata, no serif headlines.
Keep top navigation and same action locations for all variations. Use spacing, grouping, alignment and type hierarchy first, separators second, subtle tints third, borders only as needed, shadows very sparingly. Normal controls should feel 40px high, compact card actions32px. Consistent8px icon-to-label spacing. No nested cards, no loud gradients, no glass blur, no neon glow, no blobs or decorative photos. Use real-looking precise icons. No promotional slogans or arbitrary marketing copy. Keep Chinese text carefully legible. This must look implementable using current React + Tailwind + Radix controls.

candidates.name: Porcelain Duotone
candidates.prompt: Direction name: Porcelain Duotone. A confident, balanced refinement with clean flat duotone iconography and low-saturation accents. Give each row a blue duotone browser icon in a40px pale-blue tile, distinguish the proxy metadata with a small teal icon, the seed with a tiny muted brown fingerprint icon. Calm ivory cards with16px radii, controls10px radii, card padding20px and20px between rows. Card titles are the leading hierarchy; metadata is secondary but clear, actions understated. Very subtle warm shadow with a hairline border. Warm overall character, clean modern precision. Slightly strengthen the top active nav with a pale clay background and slim clay underline while keeping its original location. No 3D illustration assets. Make this feel polished, crisp and usable for hours.

candidates.name: Soft Tactile
candidates.prompt: Direction name: Soft Tactile. Explore a more expressive but restrained material interpretation of the same app and exact same content/structure. A small40px sculptural matte browser-window icon in each row header, muted blue ceramic/paper-like layered shapes with extremely restrained soft shadow, not glossy candy. Other action icons remain sharp regular SVG-style. Warm porcelain cards with20px radii, controls10px radii, padding24px, subtle warm edge lighting. A very light blue tint restricted to each row's icon-side header strip can create a softer identity; body remains ivory. Names and icons take visual priority, descriptions quieter, metadata still four aligned columns. Header module icons are tasteful two-tone clay/blue/teal/mauve. Use slightly warmer light stone canvas, unified clay primary CTA. More welcoming material feel and slightly more generous breathing room than a conventional enterprise UI, but not bulky or toy-like. No glows, no excessive gradients, no 3D world, no decorative objects outside actual icon slots. Fully readable.

candidates.name: Ink and Color
candidates.prompt: Direction name: Ink and Color. A precision-oriented, flatter and more compact interpretation of the exact same screen and three rows, with stronger typography and very clear alignment. Retain warm off-white base and clay brand, use16px row radii,10px controls,16-20px padding, very light borders and virtually no drop shadows. Make row title and fingerprint seed easier to scan with confident contrast, long metadata nicely aligned, action icons visually lighter. Thin muted-blue vertical accent line at the start of each row near a small flat duotone browser icon instead of prominent rounded icon backplates. Proxy metadata gets a restrained teal category treatment. Navigation uses very clean regular icons with active blue browser icon but clay text/underline. Preserve exact action positions and full-width stacked-card organization. This is a refined information-dense professional tool, not a spreadsheet or dark developer terminal. No drop-shadow stacking, no material/3D icons, no display headline typography. Small category accents create color while the surface remains nearly monochrome.
candidates.correction_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit of a UI mockup. Edit the provided AutoFlow browser configuration screen. Preserve absolutely all layout, exact Chinese text, all mock data, typography, spacing, borders, colors, action positions, pagination and warm palette. Target dimensions same aspect ratio as reference, 1440x1024 design coordinate space. Change ONLY the browser-identification artwork: the three large Chrome/Firefox/Edge logos at the left of the three configuration cards MUST ALL become the SAME simple blue duotone generic browser-window pictogram, a rounded rectangular application window with a thin header bar and three tiny window dots plus a small globe inside, like a Phosphor Browsers/Browser icon, about40px. No brand logos, no Chrome circle, no Firefox fox, no Edge swirl, no Safari compass. These are all CloakBrowser profiles, not different browser brands. Also replace the little browser-navigation blue circle with that same generic browser-window pictogram at20px. Keep the left blue accent stripe of each card exactly as is. Flat vector-like functional SVG style, no 3D, no decorative badge box. Keep AutoFlow's OWN brown mark and wordmark unchanged. Do not redraw other icons or any other UI. One final corrected screen only.
